title: Taco Apocalypse
description: A surreal night scene on a cobblestone path features a woman with short black hair and skull face paint kneeling beside a barbell made of stacked tacos, while a grey alien holds a large taco. The background shows a gothic cathedral covered in colorful balloon letters, taco-filled moons and planets in a starry sky with shooting stars, and swirling mist around scattered tacos and bare trees.
